Flightdeck airline pixel logos

UAL.png — United
DAL.png — Delta
AAL.png — American
SWA.png — Southwest

Each PNG is 28 x 28 pixels with a black background and a limited color palette.
United uses pure blue (#0000FF) and white; its blue pixels contain no green.
Delta uses bright red and darker red; neither half contains gray.
Southwest has yellow at the upper right, a broad red diagonal band, and blue
at the lower left. The aircraft label and progress plane are light blue (#80BFFF).
Select Airline logo in the editor and upload the PNG for the preview airline.
Choose Default (20px logo) or Logo on right (20px) from the Layout menu.
The 28 x 28 source is scaled to the default 20 x 20 display layer.
Studio upgrades recognized older factory assets in drafts and board readbacks.
Click Save to ESP32 to persist the corrections. Custom uploads stay intact;
use Use bundled pixel logo for each airline to replace a custom image.

flight-details-layout.json is a complete Flightdeck configuration, including
default filters, all four images, route, aircraft, ETA, and flight progress layers.
Use Import a saved layout to load it. Upload individual PNGs to keep your filters.
large-logo-layout.json is the earlier 28 x 28 logo arrangement, also available
through the Large logo (28px) preset.

The pack includes the original image-generation prompts. These pixel-style
adaptations now include code-native palette and Southwest diagonal corrections.
They are not official downloadable brand assets.
